source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of annihilation reactions (PDF 151-152).

blocks.text: Annihilation tab hota hai jab zarra aur us ka antiparticle qareeb aate hain: jora ghaib ho jata aur us ki kamiyat-tawanai photons ki shakal mein zahir hoti hai. Is amal mein kamiyat-tawanai aur momentum mehfooz rehte hain. Electron-positron jore ka annihilation pichhle chapter mein parha gaya.

Bunyadi zarrat ki tehqeeq mein bohat zyada tawanai chahiye, is liye zarrat ko un ki rest kamiyat ki tawanai par takrane ke bajaye taqreeban roshni ki raftar tak tez kar ke takraya jata hai. CERN ke Large Hadron Collider (LHC) mein protons aur doosre nuclei taqreeban roshni ki raftar par takraye jate hain taake ibtidai kainat jaise halaat dobara bane; TeV darje ki tawanai ki takkarein un halaat ki samajh deti hain. Aisi takkaron mein electroweak quwwat ke W+, W- aur Z bosons, jin ki peshgoi Professor Abdus Salam ne ki thi, daryaft hue, saath top aur bottom quarks aur, sab se ahem, July 2012 mein Higgs boson.

blocks.alt: Takkar ke nuqte par W/Z boson, jis ke gird chhote zarrat bikhre hain, aik W/Z boson aur Higgs boson h mein batta hai. W/Z se quark q aur antiquark q-bar, aur h se b aur b-bar quarks bante hain. Har quark zarrat ki aik bauchhar mein khatam hota hai: Jet 1, Jet 2, Jet 3, Jet 4.
blocks.caption: Aap ki maloomat ke liye: p+ aur p- ki takkar ka khaaka (kitab ke box ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Takkar se W/Z boson banta hai jo aik W/Z aur Higgs boson (h) mein badalta hai. W/Z quark aur antiquark (q, q-bar) mein, aur h bottom quark ke jore (b, b-bar) mein badalta hai; har quark zarrat ki aik 'jet' banata hai jise detector pakarta hai.

blocks.title: LHC protons ko protons se takrata hai
blocks.text: Kitab LHC mein proton-antiproton takkarein batati hai. LHC protons ko protons se (aur lead jaise bhari nuclei ko aapas mein) takrata hai; proton-antiproton takkarein pehle Tevatron aur CERN ke purane SPS mein hui thin, jahan W aur Z bosons 1983 mein pehli dafa mile. Kitab ki apni tasveer ka caption CMS detector mein 7 TeV proton-proton takkar batata hai.

Rest mein electron-positron jore ke annihilation mein nikalne wale gamma-ray photons ki tawanai maloom karein. Hal: positron aur electron dono ki kamiyat 9.1 x 10^-31 kg hai. Einstein ke talluq se E = 2mc^2 = 2 x 9.1 x 10^-31 kg x (3 x 10^8 m s^-1)^2 = 1.64 x 10^-13 J. Electron volts mein E = 1.64 x 10^-13 / 1.6 x 10^-19 = 1.02 MeV. Do gamma-ray photons nikalte hain, har aik 0.51 MeV, momentum mehfooz rakhne ke liye mukhalif simton mein.

blocks.alt: Electron e- aur positron e+ aik doosre ki taraf aa kar khatam hote hain; takkar ke nuqte se do gamma photons, har aik 0.51 MeV, mukhalif simton (oopar aur neeche) mein nikalte hain; E = 2moc^2 = 1.02 MeV.
blocks.caption: Electron-positron annihilation (asal khaaka; kitab mein is ki koi shakal nahi).

blocks.text: Jism ke andar annihilation se nikalne wale gamma-ray photons mein jism se bahar nikalne ke liye kafi tawanai hoti hai, is liye unhein jism ke bahar pakra ja sakta hai. Yeh positron emission tomography (PET) mein use hota hai: positrons chhorne wala tracer jism mein dala jata hai; har positron jald electron se mil kar khatam hota, aur mukhalif simton mein jati 0.51 MeV ki do gamma rays mareez ke gird detectors ki ring pakarti hai.

blocks.prompt: Electron-positron annihilation ke do photons mukhalif simton mein kyun nikalte hain?
blocks.explanation: Annihilation se pehle jore ka kul momentum (taqreeban) sifar hai, is liye momentum mehfooz rakhne ke liye do photons barabar aur mukhalif momentum rakhte hain: barabar tawanai (har aik 0.51 MeV) mukhalif simton mein.

items: Annihilation: zarra + antiparticle -> photons; kamiyat-tawanai aur momentum mehfooz.
e- + e+ -> mukhalif simton mein 0.51 MeV ki do gamma rays (E = 2mc^2 = 1.02 MeV).
LHC tehqeeq: W, Z (Abdus Salam ki peshgoi), Higgs boson (2012); PET annihilation use karta.
